inputs.selection: Reused exact 200 mature rounded-linspace events per scene from local_feedback_sensitivity.py; total 1200.

path_definitions.full: Perturb current omega and recompute current BS nominal torque used in neural features; BS torque output also varies.
path_definitions.omega_only: Perturb current omega feature, hold current neural nominal-torque feature at event origin; BS torque output still recomputed and varies.
path_definitions.nominal_tau_only: Hold current neural omega feature at event origin, vary current neural nominal-torque feature as BS torque is recomputed; BS torque output still varies.

inputs.frozen_conditions: Hold eta, reference/rate/acceleration, arms, prior 14 normalized feature history, beta, model, and composite W_before fixed. Only current omega is perturbed. Actual composite uses event W_before from the same v3 raw trace.
inputs.jacobian_formula: Jcomp=d(tau_comp)/domega, JBS=d(tau_BS)/domega, Jnet=JBS-Jcomp; lambda_min=eigmin(Sym(-Jnet)). Additivity check is Jcomp_full ~= Jcomp_omega_only + Jcomp_nominal_tau_only.
inputs.interpretation_limit: nominal_tau_only/omega_only are hypothetical frozen-feature local evaluations; not deployable controller modifications, causal evidence, or closed-loop/stability results. No inertia reconstruction, TEST, MATLAB, Plant, or training.
